tools.name: list_business_types
tools.description: List the schema.org LocalBusiness subtypes LocalSchema supports (Dentist, Plumber, Restaurant, …). Use the most specific one as businessType.

tools.name: generate_schema
tools.description: Generate LocalBusiness JSON-LD (schema.org) from business details and validate it against Google's rich result rules. Returns the JSON-LD, a ready-to-paste <script> tag and issues to fix. No API key needed.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Validate existing LocalBusiness structured data: paste JSON-LD, a <script type="application/ld+json"> tag or a whole HTML page. Reports errors, missing recommended fields and best-practice warnings. No API key needed.

tools.name: validate_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and audit its structured data: every JSON-LD block and type, the LocalBusiness markup's errors and warnings, LocalSchema embeds on the page and concrete recommendations. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_embed_snippet
tools.description: Get the install snippet and live status for a LocalSchema hosted embed key (loc_… for one location, org_… for a client with several). Paste the script tag once; published updates reach the site automatically.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List the agency's clients (brands) with their location counts, client-wide embed script and white-label report link. Needs a LocalSchema Pro API key in the request headers.

tools.name: save_client
tools.description: Create a client (brand) or update one by client_id, and optionally turn its white-label health report link on or off. Needs a LocalSchema Pro API key in the request headers.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List the business locations saved in the LocalSchema account: publish state, hosted embed script, website and latest health check score. Needs a LocalSchema Pro API key in the request headers.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Get one saved location: its business fields (in the same shape save_location accepts), the current JSON-LD, the published JSON-LD, validation issues and embed details. Needs a LocalSchema Pro API key in the request headers.

tools.name: save_location
tools.description: Save a business location to the LocalSchema account — create one, or update one by location_id (only the business fields you send change) — and optionally publish it to its hosted embed so the client's site updates without code changes. Needs a LocalSchema Pro API key in the request headers.

tools.name: run_health_check
tools.description: Run a schema health check for a saved location: validates its markup, scans its website for the embed and conflicting hard-coded schema, detects unpublished changes and records the result in the dashboard and client reports. Needs a LocalSchema Pro API key in the request headers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_page, get_location · Private data: generate_schema, validate_schema, validate_page, list_clients, save_client, list_locations, get_location, save_location, run_health_check · Public sink: list_locations, save_location · Destructive: run_health_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_page, get_location · Private data: generate_schema, validate_schema, validate_page, list_clients, save_client, list_locations, get_location, save_location, run_health_check · Public sink: list_locations, save_location · Destructive: run_health_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
